conversations.title: Parkinson’s drastically changed how they have sex. They're not alone.
conversations.reply: The testimony is endless: disability drastically changes how people have sex, and it's rarely discussed. Disabled people's experiences of intimacy are not invisible, they're just ignored. Able2Love was built to change this.

conversations.title: FCM Travel caution over accessibility of new digital arrival cards
conversations.reply: Accessibility is not a niche concern, it's a basic requirement. The fact that digital arrival cards might not be accessible is a reminder that disabled people are still an afterthought in many areas of life.

conversations.title: The founder of Hinge raised $18M to build a new AI dating service, Overtone
conversations.reply: Years of testimony from disabled daters says that mainstream dating apps rarely deliver on their promises of inclusivity. Able2Love exists because disabled people deserve better than tokenistic gestures or AI-powered excuses.

conversations.title: Forget Tinder: LinkedIn is the new place to find love
conversations.reply: Not invisible, just ignored: disabled people's experiences of dating are rarely discussed, even in the context of professional networking. Able2Love is here to change that.

conversations.title: A raging fire has ripped through a packed Bangkok nightclub, killing at least 27 people.
conversations.reply: An inclusive night wheelchair users can't get into is not inclusive, it's a party with a door policy nobody will put in writing. This tragedy is a reminder that accessibility is a matter of life and death.

conversations.title: Co-op extends festival sponsorship deal with Live Nation until 2031
conversations.reply: More of this: accessible festivals and events are not just a nicety, they're a necessity. Disabled people deserve to be included in all aspects of social life, not just as an afterthought.

conversations.title: Column | Asking Eric: Neighbors react badly to person with autism disorder
conversations.reply: The pattern is all too familiar: disabled people face hostility and exclusion in their daily lives, from dating to social events. Able2Love is here to provide a safe space for disabled people to connect and thrive.

conversations.title: Molly Burke - Wikipedia
conversations.reply: Molly Burke is a powerful example of a disabled person taking control of their narrative and using their platform to drive change. Able2Love is proud to amplify the voices of disabled people and provide a space for connection and community.

target_reply: Hi Molly, love your work! As a blind creator with a global reach, you're an inspiration to many. Able2Love is here to provide a safe space for disabled people to connect and thrive. Let's chat about how we can work together to promote accessibility and inclusivity in the dating world.
funding: Nothing new today, but don't forget to check out UnLtd (unltd.org.uk), Access to Work (gov.uk), and the Stelios Awards (around March) for funding opportunities.
moment: It's Disability Pride Month, and we're celebrating by promoting accessibility and inclusivity in all aspects of life, including dating. Let's make some noise and show the world that disabled people deserve to be seen, heard, and loved!
